visualReview.notes: Inspected the preview, four turns and five detailed views. Each retaining side reads continuously. Distinct details include the infilled southern arches, surviving Robinson’s Arch springing, paired east gate openings, and the upper arcades and stairs.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all ten geographic viewer views, including the overhead placement. Limestone finish, drafted lower courses, the stepped Rock Square and the Gate of Mercy read in the shared surface fixture. The placement loaded and unloaded. The inspection of the original field covered the masonry below the flat test datum.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all twenty-six contextual, detail and transition views. All four authored levels preserve the limestone enclosure, Gate of Mercy and central upper terrace. Near views retain the masonry courses, projected gates, stair risers, true arch openings and surviving arch springing.

geographicReview.notes: The 65 native outer controls define the four linked walls, with separate 83-point upper terrace control and eight native step paths. Inspected the unmasked 768 m original field and two companion scenes using the actual Dome of the Rock and Al-Aqsa placements. The published anchors produced companion datum differences below 0.51 m against their prior stored values. The terrace clears both independent buildings in the reviewed scenes. Architectural heights, stair approaches and masonry contact are approximate.

fidelityReview.scope: The standing Temple Mount / Haram al-Sharif stone enclosure in Jerusalem, with the retained platform, Western and Southern Wall faces, blocked gates, surviving Robinson’s Arch springing and stepped arcades of the upper Rock Square.
fidelityReview.notes: The eastern panorama, Gate of Mercy and Western Wall views establish the broad limestone surfaces, gate projection and differentiated ashlar. The local southern photographs establish blocked openings, fallen stone and Robinson’s Arch. The reviewed southwestern arcade establishes its three openings and broad flight. Exact levels, other arcade profiles and surface color remain estimates.

imageryReview.notes: Verified five originals in the Qualla corpus, including the renamed creator account for the Hulda photograph and documented optical correction history for the southwestern arcade. Two additional first-party originals with explicit public-domain releases establish the east tower and Western Wall. No photos are embedded.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Current geographic placement of the stone Temple Mount / Haram al-Sharif enclosure, Rock Square, retaining walls and associated masonry details in Jerusalem.

limitations: The adopted outline is the named current OpenStreetMap enclosure. Historical photographs from 2007–2009 establish the surviving walls, platforms and details. Later fixtures and exact restoration states are approximate.
Visible wall crests, thicknesses, gate reliefs, stair runs and paving planes are proportional estimates against the frozen elevation field and dated photographs.
The model covers the retaining enclosure, stone approaches and upper square. The Dome of the Rock and Al-Aqsa Mosque have existing independent placements.
